name: @openlance/aios-governance-engine
description: Phase 4 Stage 8 Governance Enforcement Engine: the Runtime's operational authorization subsystem, the operational realization of the frozen Governance namespace (the runtime validation pipeline ADR-0035 anticipated). It authorizes an immutable AgentExecutionPlan by applying the frozen governance model (permission, constitutional validation, autonomy, human oversight) and produces an immutable GovernanceDecision (AUTHORIZE / DENY / REQUIRE_APPROVAL / ESCALATE). It authorizes and stops: it executes nothing, invokes no engine, scores no risk, mints no policy and no provider clearance, is deterministic and fail-closed, and contains no vendor knowledge (ADR-0042).
